```ruby title="Ruby"

begin
  result = LiterLlm.chat(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Hello', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4', temperature: 5.0))
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
